name: Skin Color
overview: Scripture acknowledges the diversity of skin color as seen in descriptions such as Esau's red, hairy skin (Genesis 25:25) and the Ethiopian's unchangeable skin (Jeremiah 13:23). Physical appearance, including skin tone, is a part of God's creation but does not determine one's righteousness or standing before Him, as believers are called to judge rightly rather than by outward appearance (John 7:24) and God shows no partiality (Acts 10:34). Even vivid imagery like the polished brass limbs in Daniel 10:6 or the blackened skin in Lamentations 5:10 reflect circumstances or divine symbolism rather than moral value.
